name: Sorafenib (single-agent oral multikinase inhibitor)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: No predictive biomarker gates sorafenib in HCC. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Hepatocellular Carcinoma v2.2026, Principles of Biomarker Testing (HCC-J), molecular testing (MSI/dMMR, RET fusion, NTRK fusion) is used to identify subsequent-line targeted or immunotherapy options, not to select the first-line multikinase inhibitor backbone.

supportiveCare: Hand-foot skin reaction: monitor and manage; dose-modify per labeling (TKI class effect).
Liver function monitoring; hepatic-impairment dose adjustment per DeVita line 111732.
monitoring: Blood pressure at baseline and during therapy (VEGF-pathway TKI)
Liver function tests (bilirubin-based dose adjustment applies)

doseModificationRules.text: Consider half the full dose per DeVita line 111732; obtain clinical review.
No more than 200 mg once daily per DeVita line 111732; obtain clinical review.
No safe dose established per DeVita line 111732; clinical review required.

drugs.name: Sorafenib
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed. Ch. 36, line 111732. Sorafenib 400 mg PO TWICE DAILY (BID), total 800 mg/day, taken continuously (represented as days 1 to 28 of a 28-day continuous-dosing accounting cycle; there is no discrete drug-free interval). The Standard Guidelines (NCCN) HCC v2.2026 adjuvant STORM description also cites sorafenib 800 mg daily (hcc.txt line 2314). Hepatic-impairment dose adjustment per DeVita line 111732: for bilirubin 1.6 to 3x ULN consider half dose; for albumin <2.5 g/dL no more than 200 mg once daily (source DeVita prints mg/dL in error; albumin is measured in g/dL); no safe dose established for bilirubin >3x ULN.

provenance.locator: line 111732 (Ch. 36 Cancer of the Liver: sorafenib at the full dose of 400 mg twice daily for bilirubin <=1.5x ULN)
